context.problemStatement: Show four eighths as half of a whole.
context.solutionStrategy: Use the quantities given in the problem.
context.groundingProse: Divide one bar into eight equal pieces, shade four pieces. Four eighths equals one half.

content.altText: A fraction bar divided into 8 equal parts with 4 parts shaded to show four eighths.

labels.description: The numerator shows the shaded parts.
The denominator shows the total equal parts.

annotations.steps: Divide the whole bar into eight equal pieces and shade four of them.
annotations.strategy: I notice that shading half of the total eight parts shows that four eighths is the exact same amount as one half.
annotations.misconceptions: A common error is counting the dividing lines instead of the spaces between them, which leads to miscounting the denominator as nine.
annotations.connections: This connects to finding equivalent fractions by showing how different fractions can represent the same part of a whole.
